newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo cuts price of diesel model.
newsitem.headline: Volvo cuts price of diesel model.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo will cut the price of its diesel model 850 TDI by between 6,000 to 7,000 crowns this week, a company spokesman said on Monday.
"The move will be of around 6,000 to 7,000 crowns," spokesman Olle Olsson told Reuters.
Volvo said it was lowering the price so that it could compete with cheaper diesel models in Europe.
The cut in price was also expected to encourage sales of the 850 TDI that was launched last summer, Olsson said.
"We estimate that this will start to have an impact in the autumn," Olsson said.
